• Episode Overview:**
This episode of *Upanishad Ganga* explores the profound concept of the *Guru* (teacher) through the stories of Pingala and the 24 Gurus of Dattatreya Avadhoot. The episode beautifully portrays the essence of spiritual learning and self-discovery through real-life experiences and nature’s elements.
